about_the_game:
VITRIOL VR DEMO

MARCH FOR YOUR GOD

In this demo you'll play through the first 4 levels of the game gaining access to the first 2 weapons as well as the 'Fissure' Grenade and Grappling Hook.

VITRIOL is a physics based VR movement shooter. Combining speed and visceral combat with the presence and physicality of VR through physics and retro coat of paint.

Fast and Loose - Long strides and Heavy Blows churn through the wretched horde with a freedom and ease VR is yet to experience.

Hand to Skull - Physics based Enemies and an in-depth elbow estimation system provide a physicality and presence to the combat which enhances gameplay beyond what was previously possible.

Blood, Fire and Pillars of Smoke - Sinners malformed, The Righteous Risen. The Wrath of God in Iron Men. Scored by a soundtrack that hits just as hard, drowned in a haze just as thick.

content_descriptors.notes: Blow up low poly enemies and watch the 16 bit blood rain down. Mature context extends to low poly violence and occasional crude language/swearing and written descriptions of violent acts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600 3.5ghz+
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / 1660TI (6GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR !Thumbstick and (AB buttons or Trackpad) Required! Oculus Touch, Valve Index, Windows MR, HP Reverb
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations! SSD Required, 32GB Windows Virtual Memory Cache
